# Image Studio

Get every image ready for the web, social and upload forms: compress, convert, resize, crop and edit right in your browser, nothing uploaded.

10 tools. Each name opens the tool on gigai.tools, where its page explains how to use it step by step.

| Tool | What it does | Input | Output | Runs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [AI Image Upscaler](https://gigai.tools/image-upscaler) | Make small pictures bigger and sharper, a trained ESRGAN super-resolution model rebuilds edges and texture at 2x or 4x, right inside your browser. | JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP | PNG, JPG, WebP | Browser |
| [Crop Image](https://gigai.tools/crop-image) | Frame the shot with a draggable crop box, lock it to 1:1, 4:5 or 16:9, and cut out exactly the region you want. No upload, no watermark. | JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP | PNG, JPG, WebP | Browser |
| [EPS to PNG](https://gigai.tools/eps-to-png) | EPS and AI files won't open in most apps or upload to most websites. Turn them into a sharp PNG in your browser. No upload, no sign-up. | EPS, AI | PNG | Browser |
| [HEIC to JPG](https://gigai.tools/heic-to-jpg) | iPhone photos save as HEIC, which many apps and PCs can't open. Convert them to a universal JPG in your browser. No upload, no sign-up. | HEIC, HEIF | JPG, JPEG, PNG | Browser |
| [Image Compressor](https://gigai.tools/image-compressor) | Make JPG, PNG and WebP files dramatically smaller, with a live quality slider and a real before/after size comparison. | JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP | JPG, WebP | Browser |
| [Image Resizer](https://gigai.tools/image-resizer) | Set the exact width and height you need, keep the proportions locked, or snap to a social-media preset: with a clean high-quality resample and a live before/after view. | JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP | PNG, JPG, WebP | Browser |
| [JPG to PNG](https://gigai.tools/jpg-to-png) | Turn any JPG into a pixel-perfect PNG that's ready for editing, layering and transparent workflows. No re-compression, no quality loss on the way out. | JPG, JPEG | PNG | Browser |
| [PNG to JPG](https://gigai.tools/png-to-jpg) | Turn heavy PNG screenshots and exports into lightweight JPGs. Choose the fill color behind transparent pixels and dial in the quality yourself. | PNG | JPG, JPEG | Browser |
| [Remove Metadata](https://gigai.tools/remove-metadata) | Photos and PDFs quietly carry your GPS location, device and name. See exactly what a file reveals about you, then download a cleaned copy: all on your device. |  |  | Browser |
| [WebP Converter](https://gigai.tools/webp-converter) | Switch between WebP and the formats everyone already supports. Encode PNG or JPG to a lean WebP, or decode a WebP file back to PNG or JPG, both directions, one tool. | PNG, JPG, JPEG, WebP | WebP, PNG, JPG | Browser |
